'''Revah''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] hailing from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]]. A [[Decoy/Legends|decoy]] serving the [[Pirate Queen/Legends|Pirate Queen]] of the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]], Revah was active during the Sorority's conflict with the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Living on Saleucami during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Revah served the [[Pirate Queen/Legends|Pirate Queen]] of the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]] as her body double and loyal servant. Revah had served the Sorority for over a decade and had reached middle-age. She wore a mask that altered her face to maintain the ruse of her hidden identity. Though Revah hoped to become Queen herself one day, her dreams were dashed when her bodyguard, [[Mandi]], abandoned her in the Sorority's base in the [[Blackwind Crater]] and allowed her to be captured by agents of the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]]. Revah carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and [[Vibroknife/Legends|vibroknife]] for her own protection, but despite this was captured and executed.<ref name="MPQ" />
